scope: M2 independent ProductTurnRuntime binding and WorkspaceAgent Turn engine/alarm wiring

findings: an absent Workspace state returned before reconciling an existing Turn deadline
a due Turn on a non-ready Workspace re-projected a past deadline and could form an immediate alarm loop
checkpoint materialization in ProductTurnRuntime necessarily precedes WorkspaceAgent checkpointing acknowledgement, but the Journal required the opposite timestamp order
resolution: one testable alarm router advances due provisioning first, re-reads authoritative Workspace state, and then advances, defers or isolates the Turn deadline
every route reconciles the two logical deadlines onto the single physical Durable Object alarm
WorkspaceAgent now constructs WorkspaceTurnEngine with a ProductTurnRuntime client selected from the full immutable Turn identity
ProductTurnRuntime is an independent private SQLite Durable Object and a missing production release fails before core construction or storage mutation
Journal validates remote checkpoint time against execution evidence while using local commit time for terminal state and event ordering

coverage: production ProductTurnRuntime actor validation and fail-closed release in Workerd
production WorkspaceAgent create Session, durable submit, shared alarm, dispatcher, independent runtime actor, event replay and saved terminal checkpoint in Workerd
idempotent Turn submission invokes the runtime fixture once
provisioning-before-Turn ordering and authoritative state re-read
orphan Turn deadline isolation, non-ready retry and shared alarm reconciliation
remote checkpoint time preceding local checkpointing acknowledgement

observations: one M1 deadline-sensitive unit failed only while M1 and the heavy M2 Workerd suite ran concurrently; the focused test, sequential M1 suite and recorded sequential repository check all passed
the Workerd Turn chain uses explicit deterministic runtime receipt fixtures and does not prove a Pi VM, real R2 archive or provider call

productPlatform: WorkspaceAgent owns admission, durable queue, alarm routing, dispatch identity, event sequence and final Revision pointer
ProductTurnRuntime owns one identity-bound execution reservation and delegates only to platform-selected release ports
project Pi cannot select its Durable Object actor, base checkpoint, generation, release ports or terminal receipt
notAccepted: real Workspace canonical archive and restore
real Pi Session restore in a built cloud image
cloud Turn execution, logged-in SSE or M2 completion
